segments.ja193:1.1: Ayameva sā ahamapi [ahampi (sī. syā. pī.), ahamsi (ka.)] so anañño, ayameva so hatthacchinno anañño;
segments.ja193:1.3: Yamāha “komārapatī maman”ti, vajjhitthiyo natthi itthīsu saccaṃ.
segments.ja193:2.1: Imañca jammaṃ musalena hantvā, luddaṃ chavaṃ paradārūpaseviṃ;
segments.ja193:2.3: Imissā ca naṃ pāpapatibbatāya, jīvantiyā chindatha kaṇṇanāsanti.

lines: Tattha yamāha komārapatī mamanti yaṃ esā “ayaṃ me, komārapati, kuladattiko sāmiko”ti āha, ayameva so, na añño.
Ayameva hi potthakesu likhito, tassāpi ayamevattho, vacanavipallāso panettha veditabbo.
Yañhi raññā vuttaṃ, tadeva idha āgataṃ.
Natthi itthīsu saccanti etāsu sabhāvo nāmeko natthi.
Musalena hantvāti musalena hanitvā pothetvā aṭṭhīni bhañjitvā cuṇṇavicuṇṇaṃ katvā.
Imissā ca nanti ettha nanti nipātamattaṃ, imissā ca pāpapatibbatāya anācārāya dussīlāya jīvantiyāva kaṇṇanāsaṃ chindathāti attho.
